claims: Claude can ingest another AI's memory so 'it remembers everything'
After Add to memory, the imported content appears in Claude's Manage memory text
how_to_steps: In Claude, click profile > Settings > Capabilities
Under Memory, find 'Import memory from other AI providers' and click Start import

Copy the provided prompt: 'Export all of my stored memories and any context you've learned about me from past conversations. Preserve my wording verbatim where possible, especially for instructions and preferences.'
Paste it into the other AI (ChatGPT shown) and send
Copy its output, return to the Claude dialog, paste under 'Paste results below to add to Claude's memory', click Add to memory
Open Manage memory to confirm the content is stored
on_screen_only: Memory settings page: 'Search and reference chats', 'Generate memory from chat history (Allow Claude to remember relevant context from your chats...)', 'Memory from your chats -- Updated 9 hours ago', 'Import memory from other AI providers', 'Tool access mode: Load tools when needed / Tools already loaded', Visuals/Artifacts/AI-powered artifacts toggles

Dialog title: 'Import memory to Claude' with step 1 'Copy this prompt into a chat with your other AI provider' (prompt text as above, Copy button) and step 2 'Paste results below to add to Claude's memory', Cancel / Add to memory

ChatGPT output headed '## Instructions' (user prefers ChatGPT to respond..., 'User wants to be reminded...'), '## Identity', '## Career' -- 'This is the complete set of stored memories currently available'
